我是 Carry Lewis，一名医学生。我通过医学与神经科学理解生命，通过软件: I'm Carry Lewis, a medical student. I explore life through medicine and neuroscience, turn questions into working models through software, and reflect on limits, will and meaning through running, reading and faith.
这里收集我的作品、问题和逐渐形成的判断。如果某个问题也让你停下来思考，希望我们有: This is a collection of my work, questions and evolving perspectives. If a question here gives you pause too, I hope it becomes the beginning of a conversation.
我们如何理解一个人？: How do we understand a person?
从细胞、电信号到意识与经验，医学让我追问机制，也提醒我：解释生命，需要在不同尺度: From cells and electrical signals to consciousness and experience, medicine draws me toward mechanisms—and reminds me to look across scales.
理解，怎样成为有用的创造？: How does understanding become something useful?
把一个想法写成程序，让抽象机制可以被操作。对我来说，构建也是检验理解、发现盲点的: Turning an idea into software makes an abstract mechanism tangible. Building is also how I test my understanding and discover its gaps.
面对限制与不确定性，如何生活？: How do we live with limits and uncertainty?
长跑、阅读和对基督教的思考，把我带向另一些问题：什么值得相信？怎样面对限制？什么: Running, reading and reflection on Christianity lead me to other questions: what is worth believing, how do we face our limits, and what deserves a lasting commitment?
让心脏的电活动，变得可以理解。: Making the heart's electrical activity understandable.
把心脏电传导、三维解剖与十二导联 ECG 联系起来。通过操作模型，探索机制如何形: Connect cardiac conduction, 3D anatomy and the twelve-lead ECG. Explore how underlying mechanisms shape the signals we observe.
让 AI 辅助理解，把判断留给教师。: AI to support understanding. Judgment stays with the teacher.
Labwise 将实验报告原文、评分标准和 AI 建议放在同一个评阅空间，帮助教: Labwise brings report text, rubrics and AI suggestions into one workspace, helping instructors check evidence and produce reviewable feedback.
截图来自虚构测试报告；不代表生产就绪。: Screenshot uses a fictional test report; the prototype is not production-ready.

我希望这个网站能让不同领域的人找到交流的切口：也许是一个模型，一件工具，一段思考: I hope people from different fields find a reason to connect here: a model, a tool, a reflection, or a question none of us has answered yet.
从机制出发，也记得具体的人。: Start with mechanisms. Keep the person in view.
医学与神经科学吸引我的地方，在于它们连接不同的观察尺度：细胞与分子、电活动与网络: Medicine and neuroscience connect different scales of observation: cells and molecules, electrical activity and networks, and real people. I want to understand not only a conclusion, but why it holds and what it cannot yet explain.
保留了我在计算医学、生物机制与临床推理方向上的一些问题。: collect some of my questions about computational medicine, biological mechanisms and clinical reasoning.
我喜欢把问题转化为可以操作的工具。心电模拟器、报告辅助评阅与知识系统，是我尝试连: I like turning questions into tools people can use. The ECG simulator, report-review assistance and knowledge systems connect understanding with practice. A complete design is not proof of usefulness; I also want to record tradeoffs, limits and revisions.
里看看我如何探索信息的表达。: to see how I explore the expression of information.
长跑是我的兴趣之一。体能、节奏与持续投入，使“耐心”和“意志”成为具体的问题。我: Distance running is one of my interests. Physical capacity, pacing and sustained effort make patience and will tangible. I want practice, reading and reflection to inform one another, so lived experience can test an idea.
认真对待信仰，也认真对待问题。: Take faith seriously. Take questions seriously too.
我对基督教，以及佛教、伊斯兰教等思想传统感兴趣。阅读和思考这些内容，让我追问什么: I am interested in Christianity, as well as Buddhism, Islam and other traditions of thought. Reading and reflecting on them makes me ask what is worth believing, how claims respond to criticism, and how belief relates to life.
这里不试图用几句话给出完整立场。我希望在具体问题中逐渐说明自己的理解，区分已经形: A few sentences cannot express a complete position. I hope to develop my understanding through specific questions, distinguishing judgments I have formed from matters I am still exploring.
它既容纳作品，也容纳尚未完成的问题。我想留下自己如何认识世界的过程，并结识愿意认: There is room here for both work and unfinished questions. I want to record how I come to understand the world, and meet people who enjoy serious discussion and making things together.

从不同入口，理解人的处境: Different ways into the human condition
医学、神经科学、人工智能、长跑、宗教与阅读，看起来属于不同的领域。把它们放在一起: Medicine, neuroscience, artificial intelligence, running, religion and reading may seem like separate pursuits. Bringing them together does not mean I have found a theory that explains everything. They let me approach related questions in different ways.
医学让我追问生命如何运作；软件创造让我尝试把理解转成可以操作的模型；长跑使限制不: Medicine makes me ask how life works. Building software lets me turn understanding into models I can interact with. Running makes limits concrete. Reading Christianity and other traditions keeps me asking what is worth believing and what deserves lasting commitment.
构建，是检查理解的一种方式: Building as a test of understanding
一个想法在脑海里可以很完整，真正把它写成模型、做成工具时，遗漏才会显现。我希望在: An idea can feel complete in my mind. Turning it into a model or tool reveals what is missing. I want to test understanding through building, and let practice change the question in return.

则围绕报告原文、证据与教师判断组织 AI 辅助评阅。这些作品给出的是可探索的尝试: organizes AI-assisted review around report text, evidence and instructor judgment. These projects offer attempts to explore, rather than answers to every question.
我希望这里的文字既能表达判断，也能保留疑问。对于一条科学结论，需要关心证据与适用: I want my writing to express judgments while leaving room for questions. A scientific conclusion calls for attention to evidence and scope. Questions of faith and meaning also deserve an account of why I accept, question or cannot yet answer a claim.
不同的问题未必有相同的回答方式。比急于把它们统一起来更重要的，是尽可能准确地说清: Different questions may call for different ways of answering. Before trying to unify them, I want to be as precise as possible about what I currently believe, why I believe it, and what I have not worked out.
